Ava Chen: Quick prelaunch check for the webinar blog + landing — focusing SEO ops: keywords, schema, internal links, redirects, and lead routing. Who can own redirects + canonical decisions? 
Ben Kline: I can take redirects. I'll run a quick sweep of staging URLs and map old campaign links. 
Ben Kline: quick note — we should keep 301s for UTM'd legacy links for 90 days then 302 -> 301? probably 301 from day 1 :shrug: 
Sofia Ortiz: I'll own keyword mapping and schema. Will pair with content to confirm primary/secondary KW and FAQ schema. 
Miguel Alvarez: I'll do internal linking plan and wire up lead routing to Pardot. Need the final query params we want to capture. 
Ava Chen: @Ben can you paste the initial redirects snippet here so we can triage? Also add who needs access to the redirect doc. 
Ben Kline: copying my staging output:
```
# redirects.csv
/source-url,/target-url,code,reason
/blog/webinar-register, /webinar/2026-roundup,301,landing unify
/case-study-2023, /resources/case-study-2023,301,canonicalize
/promos/mar, /promos/mar-archived,301,old promo
```
Ben Kline: I'll drop full CSV in the shared drive and tag @Sofia and @Miguel. 
Sofia Ortiz: For schema, plan is: Article schema on blog post, Event + AttendanceMode on landing, and FAQPage for the Q&A. Miguel can you confirm we can render JSON-LD server-side? 
Miguel Alvarez: yes, server-side render OK. I'll add a fallback client-side injection for preview metadata. 
launch-bot: Page preview scan complete — fetch ok, meta title length 64, meta description 142, structured data: missing Event.startDate (warn). 
Ava Chen: Good catch @launch-bot — @Sofia please add startDate + timezone to Event schema. 
Sofia Ortiz: noted. Also proposing two headline variants for AB test: "How Redwood Inference Cuts Inference Costs by 3x" and "Cut LLM Inference Costs — Real benchmarks from X customers". Thoughts? 
Ben Kline: lean toward the first for bench narrative. More concrete. 
Miguel Alvarez: For internal linking, we'll add contextual links from the benchmark hub, embed CTAs in all related product pages, and ensure the landing is in the main nav during the week of event. 
Ava Chen: Lead routing: Miguel will map Pardot form -> campaign UTM -> Salesforce owner; deadline EOD Thu. 
Miguel Alvarez: Will do. Need final list of owners for SDR routing. 
Ava Chen: I'll DM final owner list. 
Sofia Ortiz: I'll push schema snippet to the wiki and include the JSON-LD examples. 
Ben Kline: tagging @people-ops for redirects who need infra access: Ben, Miguel, Sofia. 
Ava Chen: Thanks team — action items: Ben (redirect CSV + drive), Sofia (schema + KW map + headline A/B), Miguel (internal linking + lead routing), me (owner list + messaging QA). Catch-up tomorrow 10am. :rocket:
